extracted.name: Baked Sweet Potato Sticks
extracted.description: Learn how to make this simple and delicious baked sweet potato stick recipe that is the perfect side dish to any meal. Best eaten at room temperature.
ingredient_lines: 8 sweet potatoes, sliced lengthwise into quarters
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C). Lightly grease a baking sheet.
In a large bowl mix olive oil and paprika. Add potato sticks and stir by hand to coat. Place on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake 40 minutes in the preheated oven.
